stock.description: Immunotech Biopharm Ltd operates as a biopharmaceutical firm specializing in cellular immunotherapy. Its primary activities involve the investigation, development, and market introduction of T cell-based immunotherapy solutions for various cancers within the People's Republic of China. The company's flagship product, EAL, is a multi-target cellular immunotherapy currently undergoing Phase II clinical trials for the purpose of preventing liver cancer recurrence after surgery. Furthermore, Immunotech Biopharm is conducting both preclinical and clinical research on EAL for its potential use in treating lung cancer, glioma, gastric cancer, and colorectal cancer. Other pipeline assets include the 6B11-OCIK injection, which is in Phase I trials for ovarian cancer; the CAR-T-19 injection product, targeting B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukaemia; and a range of TCR-T cell products designed for solid tumor treatment. Established in 2006, the company's main office is located in Beijing, China.
